        AND (identity_method IS NULL OR identity_method IN ('document_seen', 'known_to_staff', 'authority_checked', 'portal_account'))

dsar_case_extension.name: dsar_case_extension
dsar_case_extension.value:
(extension_months IS NULL AND extension_grounds IS NULL AND extension_reason IS NULL AND extension_decided_on IS NULL)
        OR (extension_months BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND extension_grounds IS NOT NULL AND extension_grounds IN ('complex', 'multiple_requests')
          AND extension_reason IS NOT NULL AND extension_decided_on IS NOT NULL)

dsar_case_outcome.name: dsar_case_outcome
dsar_case_outcome.value:
(status = 'open' AND outcome IS NULL)
        OR (status = 'closed' AND outcome IS NOT NULL AND outcome IN ('fulfilled', 'partly_fulfilled', 'refused') AND responded_on IS NOT NULL)
        OR (status = 'withdrawn' AND outcome = 'withdrawn')

dsar_case_outcome_reason.name: dsar_case_outcome_reason
dsar_case_outcome_reason.value: outcome IS NULL OR outcome IN ('fulfilled', 'withdrawn') OR outcome_reason IS NOT NULL

dsar_case_bundle.name: dsar_case_bundle
dsar_case_bundle.value:
(bundle_sha256 IS NULL) = (bundle_issued_at IS NULL)
        AND (bundle_sha256 IS NULL) = (bundle_storage_key IS NULL)
        AND (bundle_sha256 IS NULL OR bundle_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

dsar_case_bundle_key.name: dsar_case_bundle_key
dsar_case_bundle_key.value: bundle_storage_key IS NULL OR bundle_storage_key ~ ('^dsar/tenants/' || tenant_id::text || '/' || id::text || '/[0-9a-f-]{36}[.]json$')

dsar_case_identity_first.name: dsar_case_identity_first
dsar_case_identity_first.value:
NOT identity_required OR identity_verified_on IS NOT NULL
        OR (bundle_sha256 IS NULL AND (outcome IS NULL OR outcome IN ('refused', 'withdrawn')))

dsar_item_reviewed.name: dsar_item_reviewed
dsar_item_reviewed.value:
(decision = 'pending') = (reviewed_by IS NULL AND reviewed_at IS NULL AND content_sha256 IS NULL)
        AND (content_sha256 IS NULL OR content_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

dsar_item_redaction.name: dsar_item_redaction
dsar_item_redaction.value:
(decision = 'redact') = (cardinality(redacted_fields) > 0)
        AND (decision IN ('pending', 'disclose') OR reason IS NOT NULL)

dspt_assertion_text.name: dspt_assertion_text
dspt_assertion_text.value:
char_length(btrim(title)) BETWEEN 3 AND 500
        AND (notes IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(notes)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000)
        AND (status NOT IN ('not_met', 'not_applicable') OR notes IS NOT NULL)

dspt_submission_reference.name: dspt_submission_reference
dspt_submission_reference.value: reference IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 100

security_certificate_text.name: security_certificate_text
security_certificate_text.value:
char_length(btrim(reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        AND (issuer IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(issuer)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200)

security_certificate_dates.name: security_certificate_dates
security_certificate_dates.value: expires_on IS NULL OR expires_on > issued_on

death_record_judged_by.name: death_record_judged_by
death_record_judged_by.value: judged_by IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(judged_by)) BETWEEN 3 AND 200

death_record_review.name: death_record_review
death_record_review.value:
(reviewed_at IS NULL) = (reviewed_by IS NULL)
        AND (reviewed_at IS NULL OR (coalesce(char_length(btrim(review_findings)), 0) BETWEEN 20 AND 10000
          AND coalesce(char_length(btrim(review_lessons)), 0) BETWEEN 20 AND 10000))

death_record_closed.name: death_record_closed
death_record_closed.value:
(status = 'closed') = (closed_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_by IS NOT NULL)
        AND (status = 'withdrawn') = (withdrawn_reason IS NOT NULL)
        AND (withdrawn_reason IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(withdrawn_reason)) BETWEEN 3 AND 1000)

death_step_text.name: death_step_text
death_step_text.value:
(note IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(note)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000)
        AND (reference IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
        AND (outcome = 'done' OR coalesce(char_length(btrim(note)), 0) >= 20)

herbert_profile_required.name: herbert_profile_required
herbert_profile_required.value:
char_length(btrim(physical_description)) BETWEEN 10 AND 4000
        AND char_length(btrim(places_likely)) BETWEEN 10 AND 4000

herbert_profile_text.name: herbert_profile_text
herbert_profile_text.value:
(distinguishing_features IS NULL OR char_length(distinguishing_features) <= 4000)
        AND (usual_clothing IS NULL OR char_length(usual_clothing) <= 4000)
        AND (medical_needs IS NULL OR char_length(medical_needs) <= 4000)
        AND (mobility IS NULL OR char_length(mobility) <= 4000)
        AND (communication IS NULL OR char_length(communication) <= 4000)
        AND (people_likely IS NULL OR char_length(people_likely) <= 4000)
        AND (routines IS NULL OR char_length(routines) <= 4000)
        AND (phone_or_tracker IS NULL OR char_length(phone_or_tracker) <= 1000)
        AND (previous_episodes IS NULL OR char_length(previous_episodes) <= 4000)
        AND (approach IS NULL OR char_length(approach) <= 4000)
        AND (reviewed_with IS NULL OR char_length(reviewed_with) <= 500)

missing_episode_closed.name: missing_episode_closed
missing_episode_closed.value: (status = 'closed') = (closed_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_by IS NOT NULL)

missing_event_text.name: missing_event_text
missing_event_text.value:
(kind <> 'police_called' OR coalesce(char_length(btrim(reference)), 0) BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
        AND (reference IS NULL OR kind = 'police_called')
        AND (kind <> 'search' OR coalesce(char_length(btrim(area)), 0) BETWEEN 1 AND 500)
        AND (area IS NULL OR kind = 'search')
        AND (note IS NULL OR char_length(note) <= 4000)
        AND (kind NOT IN ('found', 'welfare_check', 'debrief', 'sighting', 'note')
          OR coalesce(char_length(btrim(note)), 0) >= 10)

dependency_scale_location_key.name: dependency_scale_location_key
dependency_scale_location_key.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND location_id IS NOT NULL

dependency_scale_organisation_key.name: dependency_scale_organisation_key
dependency_scale_organisation_key.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND location_id IS NULL

dependency_scale_archived.name: dependency_scale_archived
dependency_scale_archived.value: (deleted_at IS NULL) = (archive_reason IS NULL) AND (archive_reason IS NULL OR btrim(archive_reason) <> '')

dependency_scale_version_approved.name: dependency_scale_version_approved
dependency_scale_version_approved.value: (state IN ('approved', 'superseded')) = (approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL)

disclosure_item_reviewed.name: disclosure_item_reviewed
disclosure_item_reviewed.value:
(decision = 'pending') = (reviewed_by IS NULL AND reviewed_at IS NULL AND content_sha256 IS NULL)
        AND (content_sha256 IS NULL OR content_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

disclosure_item_redaction.name: disclosure_item_redaction
disclosure_item_redaction.value:
(decision = 'redact') = (cardinality(redacted_fields) > 0)
        AND (decision IN ('pending', 'disclose') OR reason IS NOT NULL)

disclosure_request_text.name: disclosure_request_text
disclosure_request_text.value:
char_length(btrim(legal_basis)) BETWEEN 10 AND 500
        AND char_length(btrim(requester_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200
        AND char_length(btrim(requester_organisation)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200
        AND (requester_reference IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(requester_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
        AND (stated_purpose IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(stated_purpose)) BETWEEN 3 AND 2000)
        AND (reason IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(reason)) BETWEEN 3 AND 2000)

disclosure_request_purpose.name: disclosure_request_purpose
disclosure_request_purpose.value: type NOT IN ('police', 'solicitor') OR state IN ('requested', 'withdrawn') OR stated_purpose IS NOT NULL

disclosure_request_steps.name: disclosure_request_steps
disclosure_request_steps.value:
(state = 'requested' OR state = 'withdrawn' OR state = 'refused' OR (prepared_by IS NOT NULL AND prepared_at IS NOT NULL))
        AND (state NOT IN ('approved', 'released', 'refused') OR (decided_by IS NOT NULL AND decided_at IS NOT NULL))
        AND (state NOT IN ('refused', 'withdrawn') OR reason IS NOT NULL)
        AND (state = 'released') = (released_by IS NOT NULL AND released_at IS NOT NULL)

disclosure_request_approver.name: disclosure_request_approver
disclosure_request_approver.value: decided_by IS NULL OR decided_by IS DISTINCT FROM created_by

disclosure_request_pack.name: disclosure_request_pack
disclosure_request_pack.value:
(pack_sha256 IS NULL) = (pack_storage_key IS NULL)
        AND (pack_sha256 IS NULL) = (state <> 'released')
        AND (pack_sha256 IS NULL OR pack_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

disclosure_request_prevention.name: disclosure_request_prevention
disclosure_request_prevention.value:
(prevention_report_on IS NULL OR type = 'coroner')
        AND (prevention_responded_on IS NULL OR (prevention_report_on IS NOT NULL AND prevention_responded_on >= prevention_report_on))

dpia_prepared.name: dpia_prepared
dpia_prepared.value: status = 'draft' OR (version_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND prepared_at IS NOT NULL)

dpia_signed.name: dpia_signed
dpia_signed.value:
(status IN ('signed', 'superseded')) = (signed_by IS NOT NULL AND signed_at IS NOT NULL
        AND typed_name IS NOT NULL AND statement IS NOT NULL AND basis IS NOT NULL)

dpia_signer_not_preparer.name: dpia_signer_not_preparer
dpia_signer_not_preparer.value: signed_by IS NULL OR NOT (signed_by = ANY (prepared_by))

tenant_export_ready.name: tenant_export_ready
tenant_export_ready.value:
status <> 'ready' OR (ready_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at IS NOT NULL
        AND storage_key IS NOT NULL AND manifest_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND snapshot_at IS NOT NULL)

tenant_export_revoked.name: tenant_export_revoked
tenant_export_revoked.value: (status = 'revoked') = (revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_by IS NOT NULL)

tenant_export_downloaded.name: tenant_export_downloaded
tenant_export_downloaded.value:
(downloaded_at IS NULL) = (downloaded_by IS NULL)
        AND (downloaded_by IS NULL OR downloaded_by = requested_by)

tenant_export_storage_key.name: tenant_export_storage_key
tenant_export_storage_key.value: storage_key IS NULL OR storage_key = 'tenants/' || tenant_id || '/exports/' || id || '/export.zip'

import_batch_dry_run.name: import_batch_dry_run
import_batch_dry_run.value:
(dry_run_at IS NULL) = (dry_run_errors IS NULL)
        AND (dry_run_at IS NULL) = (dry_run_warnings IS NULL)
        AND coalesce(dry_run_errors, 0) >= 0 AND coalesce(dry_run_warnings, 0) >= 0

care_certificate_progress_observed.name: care_certificate_progress_observed
care_certificate_progress_observed.value:
(observed_on IS NULL) = (observed_by IS NULL)
        AND (observed_on IS NULL OR observed_on >= knowledge_assessed_on)

induction_plan_probation.name: induction_plan_probation
induction_plan_probation.value:
(probation_outcome IS NULL) = (probation_decided_on IS NULL)
        AND (probation_outcome IS NULL) = (probation_decided_by IS NULL)
        AND (probation_outcome IS NULL OR (probation_outcome IN ('passed', 'extended', 'not_passed') AND probation_ends_on IS NOT NULL))

leaver_record_exit_interview.name: leaver_record_exit_interview
leaver_record_exit_interview.value:
exit_interview IN ('not_offered', 'offered', 'declined', 'held')
        AND (exit_interview_on IS NULL) = (exit_interview <> 'held')
        AND (exit_interview_summary IS NULL OR (exit_interview = 'held' AND length(btrim(exit_interview_summary)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000))

leaver_record_access.name: leaver_record_access
leaver_record_access.value: access_removed_by IS NULL OR access_removed_at IS NOT NULL

probation_review_notes.name: probation_review_notes
probation_review_notes.value: notes IS NULL OR length(btrim(notes)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000

reference_request_state.name: reference_request_state
reference_request_state.value:
state IN ('requested', 'sent', 'declined')
        AND (state = 'sent') = (sent_on IS NOT NULL AND sent_by IS NOT NULL)
        AND (state = 'declined') = (declined_reason IS NOT NULL)
        AND (declined_reason IS NULL OR declined_reason IN ('no_consent_to_share', 'not_employed_here', 'duplicate_request'))

staff_checklist_item_kind.name: staff_checklist_item_kind
staff_checklist_item_kind.value:
(checklist = 'induction' AND kind IN ('contract_issued', 'system_access_set_up', 'uniform_and_badge', 'location_induction', 'fire_safety_briefing', 'shadowing_signed_off'))
        OR (checklist = 'leaving' AND kind IN ('property_returned', 'final_pay_notified'))

invitation_one_open_key.name: invitation_one_open_key
invitation_one_open_key.where: accepted_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL

invitation_revoked.name: invitation_revoked
invitation_revoked.value:
(revoked_at IS NULL) = (revocation_reason IS NULL)
        AND (revocation_reason IS NULL OR revocation_reason IN
          ('superseded', 'revoked', 'member_removed', 'member_changed', 'expired'))
        AND (revoked_by IS NULL OR revoked_at IS NOT NULL)

invitation_email_open_only.name: invitation_email_open_only
invitation_email_open_only.value: (email IS NOT NULL) = (accepted_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL)

invitation_final.name: invitation_final
invitation_final.value: accepted_at IS NULL OR revoked_at IS NULL

best_interests_decision_consultation.name: best_interests_decision_consultation
best_interests_decision_consultation.value:
jsonb_typeof(consultations) = 'array'
        AND (jsonb_array_length(consultations) > 0 OR no_consultation_reason IS NOT NULL)

best_interests_decision_correction_reaso.name: best_interests_decision_correction_reason
best_interests_decision_correction_reaso.value: supersedes_id IS NULL OR correction_reason IS NOT NULL

capacity_assessment_decision_kind.name: capacity_assessment_decision_kind
capacity_assessment_decision_kind.value: decision_kind IS NULL OR decision_kind IN ('care_plan', 'photos', 'social_media', 'sharing', 'marketing', 'ai_processing', 'bed_rails', 'covert_medicines')

capacity_assessment_assessor.name: capacity_assessment_assessor
capacity_assessment_assessor.value: assessor_tenant_user_id IS NOT NULL OR assessor_name IS NOT NULL

capacity_assessment_lacks.name: capacity_assessment_lacks
capacity_assessment_lacks.value:
outcome = 'has_capacity' OR (stage1_impairment AND cardinality(unable_to) > 0
        AND inability_because_of_impairment IS TRUE)

capacity_assessment_correction_reason.name: capacity_assessment_correction_reason
capacity_assessment_correction_reason.value: supersedes_id IS NULL OR correction_reason IS NOT NULL

consent_record_given_by.name: consent_record_given_by
consent_record_given_by.value:
given_by_kind IN ('person', 'representative')
        AND (given_by_kind = 'representative') = (representative_kind IS NOT NULL)

consent_record_representative.name: consent_record_representative
consent_record_representative.value:
representative_kind IS NULL OR (representative_kind IN ('lpa_health_welfare', 'lpa_property_financial', 'deputy', 'appointee', 'imca', 'advocate', 'family_or_friend')
        AND (representative_contact_id IS NOT NULL OR representative_name IS NOT NULL))

consent_record_deputy_scope.name: consent_record_deputy_scope
consent_record_deputy_scope.value: deputy_scope IS NULL OR deputy_scope IN ('personal_welfare', 'property_and_affairs')

consent_record_expiry.name: consent_record_expiry
consent_record_expiry.value: expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > given_at

consent_record_withdrawn.name: consent_record_withdrawn
consent_record_withdrawn.value: withdrawn_at IS NULL OR (withdrawn_reason IS NOT NULL AND withdrawn_at >= given_at)

dols_authorisation_outcome.name: dols_authorisation_outcome
dols_authorisation_outcome.value:
outcome IN ('pending', 'granted', 'not_granted', 'withdrawn')
        AND (outcome = 'pending' OR outcome_at IS NOT NULL)

dols_authorisation_withdrawn.name: dols_authorisation_withdrawn
dols_authorisation_withdrawn.value: outcome <> 'withdrawn' OR withdrawal_reason IS NOT NULL

dols_authorisation_period.name: dols_authorisation_period
dols_authorisation_period.value: granted_to IS NULL OR granted_from IS NULL OR granted_to > granted_from

dols_authorisation_ended.name: dols_authorisation_ended
dols_authorisation_ended.value: ended_at IS NULL OR ended_reason IS NOT NULL

dols_legal_change_review_decision.name: dols_legal_change_review_decision
dols_legal_change_review_decision.value: decision IS NULL OR decision IN ('still_deprived', 'no_longer_deprived', 'in_doubt')

dols_legal_change_review_objection.name: dols_legal_change_review_objection
dols_legal_change_review_objection.value: objection IS NULL OR objection IN ('objects', 'does_not_object', 'fluctuates', 'unclear')

dols_legal_change_review_reviewed.name: dols_legal_change_review_reviewed
dols_legal_change_review_reviewed.value: state NOT IN ('reviewed', 'referred') OR (decision IS NOT NULL AND decided_at IS NOT NULL)

dols_legal_change_review_referred.name: dols_legal_change_review_referred
dols_legal_change_review_referred.value: state <> 'referred' OR referral_sent_at IS NOT NULL

dols_legal_change_review_closed.name: dols_legal_change_review_closed
dols_legal_change_review_closed.value: state <> 'closed' OR closed_reason IS NOT NULL

outage_window.name: outage_window
outage_window.value: ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= started_at

outage_closed.name: outage_closed
outage_closed.value:
(state IN ('closed', 'reconciled')) = (closed_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_by IS NOT NULL
        AND ended_at IS NOT NULL AND back_entry_due_at IS NOT NULL)

outage_reconciled.name: outage_reconciled
outage_reconciled.value:
(state = 'reconciled') = (reconciled_at IS NOT NULL AND reconciled_by IS NOT NULL
        AND reconciliation_statement IS NOT NULL AND forms_entered IS NOT NULL)

outage_words.name: outage_words
outage_words.value:
(reconciliation_statement IS NULL OR btrim(reconciliation_statement) <> '')
        AND (cancellation_reason IS NULL OR btrim(cancellation_reason) <> '')
        AND (correction_reason IS NULL OR btrim(correction_reason) <> '')

outage_cancelled.name: outage_cancelled
outage_cancelled.value:
(state = 'cancelled') = (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_by IS NOT NULL
        AND cancellation_reason IS NOT NULL)

break_glass_kind.name: break_glass_kind
break_glass_kind.value:
kind IN ('open', 'search') AND (kind = 'open') = (person_id IS NOT NULL)
        AND (kind = 'open' OR expires_at = opened_at)

break_glass_reason_code.name: break_glass_reason_code
break_glass_reason_code.value: reason_code IS NULL OR reason_code IN ('emergency_care', 'covering_another_area', 'safeguarding', 'incident_or_complaint', 'request_from_professional', 'other')

contact_authority_scope.name: contact_authority_scope
contact_authority_scope.value: authority_scope IS NULL OR authority_scope IN ('personal_welfare', 'property_affairs', 'both')

person_communication_none_identified.name: person_communication_none_identified
person_communication_none_identified.value:
communication_needs_status <> 'none_identified' OR (communication_needs = '[]'::jsonb
        AND communication_needs_confirmed_by IS NOT NULL AND communication_needs_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL)

placement_trial_end.name: placement_trial_end
placement_trial_end.value: trial_ends_on IS NULL OR trial_ends_on > start_date

about_me_share_link_revoked.name: about_me_share_link_revoked
about_me_share_link_revoked.value: revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_reason IS NOT NULL

admission_decision_trial.name: admission_decision_trial
admission_decision_trial.value: trial_ends_on IS NULL OR planned_admission_on IS NULL OR trial_ends_on > planned_admission_on

admission_decision_correction_reason.name: admission_decision_correction_reason
admission_decision_correction_reason.value: supersedes_id IS NULL OR correction_reason IS NOT NULL

bed_occupancy_range.name: bed_occupancy_range
bed_occupancy_range.value: to_date IS NULL OR to_date > from_date

break_glass_weekly_report_review.name: break_glass_weekly_report_review
break_glass_weekly_report_review.value:
(reviewed_by IS NULL) = (reviewed_at IS NULL)
        AND (supersedes_id IS NULL) = (reviewed_by IS NULL)

care_plan_change_source_once.name: care_plan_change_source_once
care_plan_change_source_once.where: source_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

care_plan_change_source.name: care_plan_change_source
care_plan_change_source.value:
(source_type IS NULL) = (source_id IS NULL) AND (source_type IS NULL
        OR source_type IN ('incident', 'hospital_transfer', 'care_note', 'assessment', 'other'))

care_plan_change_reviewed.name: care_plan_change_reviewed
care_plan_change_reviewed.value: review_record_id IS NULL OR reviewed_on IS NOT NULL

exit_checklist_item_done.name: exit_checklist_item_done
exit_checklist_item_done.value: status = 'pending' OR (done_by IS NOT NULL AND done_at IS NOT NULL)

exit_checklist_item_not_required.name: exit_checklist_item_not_required
exit_checklist_item_not_required.value: status <> 'not_required' OR (allow_not_required AND reason IS NOT NULL)

exit_checklist_item_evidence.name: exit_checklist_item_evidence
exit_checklist_item_evidence.value:
(evidence_type IS NULL) = (evidence_id IS NULL) AND (evidence_type IS NULL
        OR evidence_type IN ('statutory_notification', 'document', 'ledger_entry', 'note'))

exit_record_one_open.name: exit_record_one_open
exit_record_one_open.where: state NOT IN ('closed', 'cancelled') AND deleted_at IS NULL

exit_record_status_before.name: exit_record_status_before
exit_record_status_before.value: status_before IS NULL OR status_before IN ('active', 'on_leave', 'in_hospital')

exit_record_state.name: exit_record_state
exit_record_state.value:
state IN ('planned', 'left', 'recorded', 'awaiting_return', 'closed', 'cancelled') AND CASE WHEN kind = 'death'
        THEN state NOT IN ('planned', 'left') ELSE state <> 'recorded' END

exit_record_death.name: exit_record_death
exit_record_death.value:
CASE WHEN kind = 'death'
        THEN place_of_death IN ('care_home', 'hospital', 'elsewhere') AND left_at IS NOT NULL
        ELSE place_of_death IS NULL AND death_expected IS NULL END

exit_record_destination.name: exit_record_destination
exit_record_destination.value:
destination_type IS NULL OR destination_type IN ('own_home', 'family_home', 'care_home',
        'hospital', 'hospice', 'supported_living', 'other')

exit_record_left.name: exit_record_left
exit_record_left.value: state IN ('planned', 'cancelled') OR left_at IS NOT NULL

exit_record_cancelled.name: exit_record_cancelled
exit_record_cancelled.value: state <> 'cancelled' OR cancelled_reason IS NOT NULL

exit_record_closed.name: exit_record_closed
exit_record_closed.value: state <> 'closed' OR closed_at IS NOT NULL

hospital_transfer_one_open.name: hospital_transfer_one_open
hospital_transfer_one_open.where: returned_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

hospital_transfer_returned.name: hospital_transfer_returned
hospital_transfer_returned.value: returned_at IS NULL OR returned_at >= left_at

hospital_transfer_acknowledgement.name: hospital_transfer_acknowledgement
hospital_transfer_acknowledgement.value: (ack_by IS NULL) = (ack_at IS NULL) AND (ack_by IS NULL) = (ack_reason IS NULL)

key_issue_returned.name: key_issue_returned
key_issue_returned.value: returned_on IS NULL OR returned_on >= issued_on

key_issue_lost.name: key_issue_lost
key_issue_lost.value: reported_lost_on IS NULL OR reported_lost_on >= issued_on

key_issue_once.name: key_issue_once
key_issue_once.value: returned_on IS NULL OR reported_lost_on IS NULL

pre_admission_assessment_involvement.name: pre_admission_assessment_involvement
pre_admission_assessment_involvement.value: person_involved IS NOT FALSE OR involvement_reason IS NOT NULL

property_item_acknowledgement.name: property_item_acknowledgement
property_item_acknowledgement.value:
ack_signer IN ('person', 'representative', 'unable_to_sign') AND CASE WHEN ack_signer = 'unable_to_sign'
        THEN ack_unable_reason IS NOT NULL ELSE ack_name IS NOT NULL END

property_item_witness.name: property_item_witness
property_item_witness.value: witnessed_by IS NULL OR witnessed_by <> recorded_by

property_item_returned.name: property_item_returned
property_item_returned.value:
status <> 'returned' OR (returned_on IS NOT NULL AND return_recipient_name IS NOT NULL
        AND return_recipient_capacity IN ('person', 'representative', 'personal_representative', 'receiving_provider') AND returned_by IS NOT NULL
        AND return_signer IN ('person', 'representative', 'unable_to_sign'))

property_item_disposed.name: property_item_disposed
property_item_disposed.value:
status <> 'disposed' OR (disposed_on IS NOT NULL AND disposal_reason IS NOT NULL
        AND disposed_by IS NOT NULL AND disposal_witnessed_by IS NOT NULL
        AND disposal_witnessed_by <> disposed_by)

property_item_lost.name: property_item_lost
property_item_lost.value: status <> 'lost' OR (lost_on IS NOT NULL AND loss_incident_id IS NOT NULL)

review_record_family.name: review_record_family
review_record_family.value:

timesheet_entry_times.value: ended_at > started_at AND ended_at - started_at <= interval '25 hours'

timesheet_entry_approved.name: timesheet_entry_approved
timesheet_entry_approved.value: (status = 'approved') = (approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_by IS NULL OR approved_by <> worker_id)

timesheet_entry_correction.name: timesheet_entry_correction
timesheet_entry_correction.value: (supersedes_id IS NULL) = (correction_reason IS NULL) AND (correction_reason IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(correction_reason)) BETWEEN 3 AND 500)

working_time_opt_out_ends.name: working_time_opt_out_ends
working_time_opt_out_ends.value: ends_on IS NULL OR ends_on >= signed_on

working_time_opt_out_notice.name: working_time_opt_out_notice
working_time_opt_out_notice.value: (notice_amount IS NULL) = (notice_unit IS NULL) AND (notice_unit IS NULL OR (notice_unit IN ('days', 'months') AND notice_amount BETWEEN 0 AND 365))

working_time_opt_out_notice_given.name: working_time_opt_out_notice_given
working_time_opt_out_notice_given.value: notice_given_on IS NULL OR notice_given_on >= signed_on

task_sync_open_source_key.name: task_sync_open_source_key
task_sync_open_source_key.where: status IN ('open', 'in_progress') AND deleted_at IS NULL AND kind IN ('sync.device_hold', 'sync.entry_reported_deleted', 'sync.entry_deleted_after_upload', 'care.refused_entry_review')

task_cancel_code.name: task_cancel_code
task_cancel_code.value: cancel_code IS NULL OR (status = 'cancelled' AND cancel_code IN ('paused_while_away', 'ended_at_exit', 'exit_recorded_in_error', 'planned_exit_cancelled', 'missed_before_return_recorded'))

task_restore_code.name: task_restore_code
task_restore_code.value: restore_code IS NULL OR restore_code IN ('caught_up', 'answered_while_stopped')

task_series_care_plan_action_key.name: task_series_care_plan_action_key
task_series_care_plan_action_key.where: source_type = 'care_plan_action' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (active OR inactive_code IS NOT NULL)

task_series_inactive_code.name: task_series_inactive_code
task_series_inactive_code.value: inactive_code IS NULL OR (NOT active AND inactive_code IN ('paused_while_away', 'ended_at_exit', 'exit_recorded_in_error', 'planned_exit_cancelled', 'missed_before_return_recorded'))

compliance_item_risk_assessment.name: compliance_item_risk_assessment
compliance_item_risk_assessment.value:
(risk_assessment_signed_on IS NULL) = (risk_assessment_signed_by IS NULL)
        AND (risk_assessment_signed_on IS NULL OR kind = 'dbs_certificate')

revalidation_evidence_counts.name: revalidation_evidence_counts
revalidation_evidence_counts.value:
practice_hours BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND cpd_hours BETWEEN 0 AND 1000
        AND participatory_cpd_hours BETWEEN 0 AND cpd_hours
        AND feedback_pieces BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND reflective_accounts BETWEEN 0 AND 100

staff_profile_registration_body.name: staff_profile_registration_body
staff_profile_registration_body.value: registration_body IS NULL OR registration_body IN ('nmc', 'hcpc', 'swe', 'gmc')

staff_profile_left_after_start.name: staff_profile_left_after_start
staff_profile_left_after_start.value: left_on IS NULL OR starts_on IS NULL OR left_on >= starts_on

training_record_tier.name: training_record_tier
training_record_tier.value: (tier IS NULL) = (topic <> 'oliver_mcgowan') AND (tier IS NULL OR tier IN (1, 2))

training_record_expiry.name: training_record_expiry
training_record_expiry.value: expires_on IS NULL OR expires_on >= completed_on

training_record_provider.name: training_record_provider
training_record_provider.value: provider IS NULL OR length(btrim(provider)) BETWEEN 2 AND 160

training_requirement_refresh.name: training_requirement_refresh
training_requirement_refresh.value: refresh_years IS NULL OR refresh_years BETWEEN 1 AND 10

training_requirement_tier.name: training_requirement_tier
training_requirement_tier.value: (tier IS NULL) = (topic <> 'oliver_mcgowan') AND (tier IS NULL OR tier IN (1, 2))
